newsitem.title: UK: Tax must remain decision for EU states - UK minister.
newsitem.headline: Tax must remain decision for EU states - UK minister.

text.p: A British treasury minister said on Thursday that taxation policies must continue to be decided by individual member states of the European Union.

Michael Jack was speaking to parliament after the Independent newspaper claimed that France and Germany were proposing to harmonise tax across the countries which join up to a single European currency.
Asked whether Britain would oppose any such move -- which was denied earlier by both Paris and Bonn -- Jack pointed to a statement last March by Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke.
Clarke said then he personally strongly take the view that taxation policies were decisions for member states of the EU and must remain so.
"I think that is a clear statement of our policy," Jack said.

An aide to Prime Minister John Major said earlier that Britain would refuse to involve itself in any plan by other European Union states to harmonise their tax policies. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
